response.sql:
WITH equipment_averages AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  GROUP BY equipref
), reference_averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS all_equipment_avg
  FROM equipment_averages
), kept AS (
  SELECT ea.equipref, ea.avg_humidity,
         ea.avg_humidity - ra.all_equipment_avg AS excess
  FROM equipment_averages AS ea
  CROSS JOIN reference_averages AS ra
  WHERE ra.all_equipment_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND ea.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
    AND ea.avg_humidity > ra.all_equipment_avg
), kept_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS mean_kept_humidity
  FROM kept
)
SELECT k.equipref,
       k.avg_humidity,
       k.excess,
       k.avg_humidity - km.mean_kept_humidity AS difference_from_kept_mean
FROM kept AS k
CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS km
WHERE km.mean_kept_humidity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The all-equipment average is the unweighted mean of per-equipment humidity averages, and each equipment average ignores NULL readings as SQLite AVG does.
